signature: DOUBLE PRECISION FUNCTION ZLA_GERPVGRW( N, NCOLS, A, LDA, AF,

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of linear equations, i.e., the order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: ncols
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix A. $\mathrm{NCOLS} \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the N-by-N matrix A.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: AF
params.reference: The factors L and U from the factorization $A = P \, L \, U$ as computed by ZGETRF.

params.name: ldaf
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `AF`. $\mathrm{LDAF} \ge \max (1,N)$.
